assumption_id.description: Enumerate the assumption items starting from 'A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', etc. Do not restart at A1.
assumption_id.title: Assumption Id

statement.description: The core assumption we are making that, if false, would kill the project.
statement.title: Statement

test_now.description: A concrete, immediate action to test if this assumption is true.
test_now.title: Test Now

falsifier.description: The specific result from the test that would prove the assumption false.
falsifier.title: Falsifier

failure_mode_index.description: Enumerate the failure_mode items starting from 1
failure_mode_index.title: Failure Mode Index

root_cause_assumption_id.description: The 'assumption_id' (e.g., 'A1') of the single assumption that is the primary root cause of this failure mode.
root_cause_assumption_id.title: Root Cause Assumption Id

failure_mode_title.description: A compelling, story-like title (e.g., 'The Gridlock Gamble').
failure_mode_title.title: Failure Mode Title

risk_analysis.description: Structured, factual breakdown of causes, contributing factors, and impacts for the failure mode. Use bullet points or short factual sentences. Avoid narratives or fictional elements.
risk_analysis.title: Risk Analysis

early_warning_signs.description: Clear, measurable indicators that this failure mode may occur. Each must be objectively testable.
early_warning_signs.title: Early Warning Signs

owner.description: The single role who owns this risk (e.g., 'Permitting Lead', 'Head of Engineering').
owner.title: Owner

likelihood_5.description: Integer from 1 (rare) to 5 (almost certain) of this failure occurring.
likelihood_5.title: Likelihood 5

impact_5.description: Integer from 1 (minor) to 5 (catastrophic) if this failure occurs.
impact_5.title: Impact 5

tripwires.description: Array of 2-3 short, specific strings with NUMERIC thresholds that signal this failure is imminent (e.g., 'Permit delays exceed 90 days').
tripwires.title: Tripwires

playbook.description: Array of exactly 3 brief, imperative action steps for the owner to take if a tripwire is hit.
playbook.title: Playbook

stop_rule.description: A single, short, hard stop condition that would trigger project cancellation or a major pivot.
stop_rule.title: Stop Rule

assumptions_to_kill.description: A list of 3 new, critical, underlying assumptions to test immediately.
assumptions_to_kill.title: Assumptions To Kill

failure_modes.description: A list containing exactly 3 distinct failure failure_modes, one for each archetype.
failure_modes.title: Failure Modes
